raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), which is the batch delivery date and falls one day after the actual transaction date. All 4600 POSTED rows are therefore mismatched, and every gold table grouped by txn_date is shifted by a day. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts fixes silver and, through it, the gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
